intent.proves: At least one active, non-service user of the default user type has a username.
intent.scope: all AccessUser rows of user type Default (5); service accounts excluded; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: search_users returns a paged envelope; mcp-count must read the total, not the page length, and the tool's filters cannot express this predicate. Handler projection pending.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUser WHERE AccessUserType = 5 AND AccessUserActive = 1 AND ISNULL(AccessUserUserName,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(AccessUserIsServiceAccount,0) = 0
